description: Is public DNS having trouble right now? Every public resolver isitdns watches, tier-1 first: one label each, each probe's timestamped reading (the question, the resolver address, the probe, family and transport, the answer or failure, flags, rcode, EDE, latency), and a fresh read from the edge. When answering, give the readings behind the label; never 'DNS is fine' or 'resolver X is down' without them. Give a resolver for one card. Give the person the api: and ask again: lines as printed.

resolver.description: One resolver by id (cloudflare, google, quad9, opendns, adguard, cleanbrowsing, controld, quad9-unfiltered, adguard-family, cleanbrowsing-family, adguard-unfiltered, opendns-familyshield, nextdns, cloudflare-malware, cloudflare-family, mullvad-base, dns4eu-protective), alias or address; omit for the whole board
